title: Lionel Messi set for Argentina return in Inter Miami friendly at Estadio Monumental
content:
Inter Miami will face River Plate in a pre-season friendly at Estadio Monumental, Buenos Aires in January, bringing Lionel Messi back to Argentina after his international retirement.

It will be a first-ever fixture between the two clubs, and a return to the stadium in which Messi, 39, made his final international appearance in October. The friendly has been scheduled for January 19, 2027.

In statements issued on both clubs’ official websites, they said the friendly, organised by private investment fund COC Global, will aim to “deliver an experience that extends beyond the 90 minutes on the field” and “celebrate the growth and international reach of both clubs”.

The fixture will give Messi the chance to play in front of his home crowd once more after bringing an end to his 21-year international career last month.

Messi, who captained Argentina to their World Cup success in 2022 and retired as the nation’ s most-capped player (208) and all-time top goalscorer (126), scored once and provided two assists as Argentina beat Benin 3-0 at Estadio Monumental, the home of River Plate, where his career was celebrated in front of around 85,000 fans.

In August, he announced his decision to retire from international football after leading Argentina to the World Cup final in the United States, Canada and Mexico, where they were beaten 1-0 by Spain after extra-time, and following the death of his father, Jorge.

Estadio Monumental is a significant venue for Messi. He scored 20 international goals at the 85,018-capacity stadium, more than any other venue for Argentina, and it is where he and his international team-mates returned home to celebrate their World Cup success in 2022.

The friendly will fall around a month after the conclusion of the MLS season, with the MLS Cup final scheduled for December 18. Inter Miami face the Columbus Crew in the first leg of their first-round series on November 21.

Meanwhile, River Plate, the 37-time Argentinian league champions, face Lanus on November 22 in the last 16 of the 2026 Torneo Clausura.
